clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements of socketed asbestos cement building and sanitary pipes and pipe fittings of diameter 50 to 150 mm for use as rain water pipes, soil, waste and ventilating pipes.

clauses.title: The followings pipes and
clauses.text: 1.1 The followings pipes and pipe fittings are covered— a) Single socketed pipe, b) Loose socket, c) Plain bend, d) Swan neck, e) Sanitary bend, f) Single and double equal junctions, g) Single and double unequal junctions, h) Single and double equal inverted junctions with spigot branch, j) Hexagonal rain water head, k) Shoe, m) Cone cap cowl, n) Slotted vent cowl, and p) W.C. connectors,

clauses.title: Workmanship
clauses.text: 2. Workmanship— The interior surface of the pipes and pipe fittings should be regular.

clauses.title: Dimensional Requirements
clauses.text: 3. Dimensional Requirements

clauses.title: Nominal Diameter and Thickness
clauses.text: 3.1 Nominal Diameter and Thickness— The nominal diameter of the pipes and pipe fittings corresponds to the internal diameter (bore), tolerances not being taken into account.

clauses.title: Length
clauses.text: 3.2 Length

clauses.title: Nominal Length
clauses.text: 3.2.1  Nominal Length — The nominal lengths of pipes correspond to the useful lengths of the socketed pipes exclusive of internal depth of socket, not taking tolerance into account, and shall be 500, 1000, 1500, 1830, 2000 2440 and 3000 mm. SUMMARY OF IS  1626 (PART 1) : 1994 ASBESTOS CEMENT BUILDING PIPES AND PIPE FITTINGS, GUTTERS, AND GUTTER FITTINGS AND ROOF FITTINGS PART 1 PIPES AND PIPE FITTINGS (Second Revision)

clauses.title: Overall Length
clauses.text: 3.2.2 Overall Length — The overall length is the sum of nominal length and length of socket.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 3.3 Tolerances

clauses.title: Internal diameter of plain ends and sockets
clauses.text: 3.3.1 Internal diameter of plain ends and sockets: The ratio of the actual diameter (maximum or minimum bore of pipes, pipe fittings or sockets measured over a given section) and the nominal diameter (bore of pipes, pipe fittings or sockets) should lie between 0.95 and 1.05 for all diameters of pipes and pipe fittings.

clauses.title: The nominal length
clauses.text: 3.3.2 The nominal length— The tolerances on nominal length of pipes and pipe fittings shall be      ± 10 mm and ± 5 mm respectively.

clauses.title: The overall length
clauses.text: 3.3.3  The overall length— The tolerances on the overall lengths of pipes shall be  ± 10 mm.

clauses.title: The depth of socket
clauses.text: 3.3.4 The depth of socket — The tolerances on the depth of the sockets of pipe fittings shall be  ± 5 mm.

clauses.title: Physical Requirements
clauses.text: 4. Physical Requirements

clauses.title: The deviation in straightness
clauses.text: 4.1 The deviation in straightness of pipes shall not exceed the following— Nominal Diameter Deviation m m m m 50 to 60 5.5l 80 to 150 4.5l where l is the nominal length of the pipe in metres

clauses.title: Hydraulic Pressure Test
clauses.text: 4.2  Hydraulic Pressure Test — To be carried out on  all pipes and fittings except on cone cap cowl, slotted vent cowl and pipe fittings provided with access doors.

clauses.title: Pipes and fittings shall
clauses.text: 4.2.1 Pipes and fittings shall show no fissure or visible sweating on outside surface when subjected to internal hydraulic pressure of 0.1 MN/m 2   maintained for 30 seconds.

clauses.title: Hydraulic bursting test
clauses.text: 4.2.2 Hydraulic bursting test — (optional for pipes only) the pipe shall indicate a minimum bursting stress of 5 MN/m2

clauses.title: Longitudinal bursting test
clauses.text: 4.2.3 Longitudinal bursting test — The unit longitudinal bending stress shall not be less than 12.5 MN/m2.

clauses.title: Transverse crushing test
clauses.text: 4.2.4 Transverse crushing test — The unit transverse crushing stress of pipes at failure shall not be less than 14 MN/m2.

clauses.title: Water absorption test
clauses.text: 4.2.5 Water absorption test— The mean water absorption of speciment shall not be more than 28 percent of the dry mass of the material. Note— For methods of tests, refer to IS 5913:1989 Method of tests for asbestos cement products (first revision) For detailed information refer to IS 1626 (Part 1):1984 Specification for asbestos cement building pipes and pipe fittings, gutters and gutter fittings and roof fittings: Part 1 Pipes and pipe fittings (second revision).
